verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Those who wait upon the Lord
They will find their strength will be restored

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
They will run and not grow wear - y
They will walk and not grow faint

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Better is a day with You
Than a thousand elsewhere
Wherever You are there I will be

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And I don’t need to hurry
When I’m in Your presence
Wherever You are there I will be

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I’d rather be a doorkeeper
In the house of the Lord than anywhere else
I’d rather be in the courts of my God

verse.lines:
I’d rather be a doorkeeper
